criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Physician Note: 'CHIEF COMPLAINT: Neck and right arm pain... radiating down the right upper extremity'. Symptoms are cervical, not lumbar.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Less than clinically meaningful improvement with conservative management (medications and/or exercise) for the required duration (3 months for Spondylolisthesis/Deformity, 12 months for DDD).

criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Physician Note: 'No unmanaged major depressive disorder, psychiatric illness, or substance abuse disorder.'

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Documentation of nicotine-free status (never-smoker or 6+ weeks abstinence with negative cotinine).
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Lab Report: 'URINE COTININE SCREEN... RESULT: Negative... Specimen confirms tobacco / nicotine abstinence (>6 weeks duration)'.

notes: The requested procedure (CPT 22853) and clinical indication ('Cage Insertion Without Arthrodesis') are being evaluated against a policy for Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609). The submitted medical records exclusively document cervical spine pathology (C5-C6 disc collapse, cervical radiculopathy) and cervical conservative management. There is no documentation of lumbar spine pathology, lumbar symptoms, or lumbar-specific imaging. Furthermore, the duration of conservative management (8 weeks) does not meet the minimum thresholds (3-12 months) required by the policy for any lumbar fusion indication. Therefore, the criteria for medical necessity under the Lumbar Fusion policy are not met.
